# ----------------

```{r, message = FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidypaleo) 

```

# --------------------
## Tidypaleo graphs ##
# --------------------

# ------- Baiau Superior --------

```{r, Pre-treatment}

# Initial long-format data frame (raw data):
ba_sup_raw_df <- read.csv("Select your directory/Unified_raw_dataframes/baiau_superior_raw_unified_data_frame.csv", sep = ";")

ba_sup_xrf <- ba_sup_raw_df %>%
    distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
    select(-location, -zone, -No, -Species_ID, -Inc, -Coh, -perc.C, -perc.N, -d15N, -d13C) 

# Into long format:
ba_sup_xrf_long <- ba_sup_xrf %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = Al:Pb, names_to = "parameter", values_to = "values") %>% 
  arrange(parameter)

# Weighted average for Baiau Superior:
ba.element.wa <- ba_sup_xrf_long %>% 
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(weighted.avg.depth = weighted.mean(mean.depth, w = values, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  arrange(weighted.avg.depth)

#Baiau Superior:
ba_sup_xrf_long <- ba_sup_xrf_long %>% 
  mutate(element = factor(parameter, levels = ba.element.wa$parameter))

```

```{r, Tidyplots}

# Plot without the age:
ba.xrf.tp <- ba_sup_xrf_long %>% #The data frame containing the weighted average ordering.
  ggplot(aes(x = values, y = mean.depth)) +
  geom_lineh() +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  facet_geochem_gridh(vars(element), scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Counts per second", 
    y = "Depth (cm)", 
    title = "Baiau Superior"
    ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(), #Remove panel background.
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), #Remove major gridlines.
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), #Remove minor gridlines.
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")
  )
ba.xrf.tp

# --------- Adding the age -----------

# Dataframes with the ages (generated with rbacon package for the subsampling resolution):
ba21_ages <- read.csv("Select your directory/Ages_tidypaleo/ba_ages_tidypaleo.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ";")

# Baiau Superior's age model:
ba_age_depth <- age_depth_model(.data = ba21_ages, #Nombre de la dataframe con las profundidades y las edades
                         depth = ba21_ages$depth, #Nombre de la columna de profundidades
                         age = ba21_ages$mean, #Nombre de la columna de edades medias
                         age_min = ba21_ages$min, #Nombre de la columna de error mínimo
                         age_max = ba21_ages$max #Nombre de la columna de error máximo
                         )

# With the age:
ba.xrf.tp.age <- ba.xrf.tp +
  scale_y_depth_age(ba_age_depth, age_name = "Age (cal yr BP)")

ba.xrf.tp.age

```

# ------- Baiau Inferior --------

```{r, Pre-treatment}

# Initial long-format data frame (raw data):
ba_inf_raw_df <- read.csv("Select your directory/Unified_raw_dataframes/baiau_inferior_raw_unified_data_frame.csv", sep = ";")

ba_inf_xrf <- ba_inf_raw_df %>%
    distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
    select(-location, -zone, -No, -Species_ID, -Inc, -Coh, -perc.C, -perc.N, -d15N, -d13C) 

# To remove the first 6 samples only from Baiau Inferior (just in case):
ba_inf_xrf <- ba_inf_xrf[-c(1:6), ] #There're no XRF data. I want to explore the element tendencies without the 0 values. Update: It's basically the same.

# To remove the last 2 samples only from Baiau Inferior (just in case):
ba_inf_xrf <- ba_inf_xrf[-c(116, 117), ] #There're no XRF data.

# Into long format:
ba_inf_xrf_long <- ba_inf_xrf %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = Al:Pb, names_to = "parameter", values_to = "values") %>% 
  arrange(parameter)

# Weighted average for Baiau Superior:
bain.element.wa <- ba_inf_xrf_long %>% 
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(weighted.avg.depth = weighted.mean(mean.depth, w = values, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  arrange(weighted.avg.depth)

#Baiau Superior:
ba_inf_xrf_long <- ba_inf_xrf_long %>% 
  mutate(element = factor(parameter, levels = bain.element.wa$parameter))

```

```{r, Tidypaleo}

# Plot without the age:
bain.xrf.tp <- ba_inf_xrf_long %>% #The data frame containing the weighted average ordering.
  ggplot(aes(x = values, y = mean.depth)) +
  geom_lineh() +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  facet_geochem_gridh(vars(element), scales = "free") + #The 'element' column sorts by the weighted averaging. 
  labs(
    x = "Counts per second", 
       y = "Depth (cm)", 
       title = "Baiau Inferior"
    ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(), #Remove panel background.
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), #Remove major gridlines.
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), #Remove minor gridlines.
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")
  )

bain.xrf.tp

# --------- Adding the age -----------

# Dataframes with the ages (generated with rbacon package; see above):
bain21_ages <- read.csv("Select your directory/Ages_tidypaleo/bain_ages_tidypaleo.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ";")

# Baiau Superior's age model:
bain_age_depth <- age_depth_model(.data = bain21_ages, #Nombre de la dataframe con las profundidades y las edades
                         depth = bain21_ages$depth, #Nombre de la columna de profundidades
                         age = bain21_ages$mean, #Nombre de la columna de edades medias
                         age_min = bain21_ages$min, #Nombre de la columna de error mínimo
                         age_max = bain21_ages$max #Nombre de la columna de error máximo
                         )

# With the age:
bain.xrf.tp.age <- bain.xrf.tp +
  scale_y_depth_age(bain_age_depth, age_name = "Age (cal yr BP)")

bain.xrf.tp.age

```
